Increases your movement speed while in Cat Form by 30%, and increases your chance to Dodge by 4%.

talents.name: Leader of the Pack

Increases your Intellect by 4%. In addition, while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form your Stamina is increased by 8% and while in Cat Form your Strength is increased by 4%.

Reduces the mana cost of all shapeshifting by 20%.

Reduces the threat generated by your Nature and Arcane spells by 20%.
Reduces the threat generated by your Nature and Arcane spells by 30%.

talents.name: Wild Growth
rankEffects: Heals the target and their party for 336 over 7 sec. Party members must be within 43.5 yards of target. The amount healed is applied quickly at first, and slows down as Wild Growth reaches its full duration.

abilities.name: Blood Fury
abilities.effect: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Increases Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Hardiness
abilities.effect: Duration of Stun effects on you reduced by 20%.

abilities.name: Command
abilities.effect: Damage dealt by Hunter and Warlock pets increased by 5%.

abilities.name: Shatter Curse
abilities.effect: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Instantly removes all Curses and Banes, and reduces all Magical damage taken by 5% for 8 sec.

abilities.name: Underwater Breathing
abilities.effect: Underwater breath lasts 300% longer than normal.

abilities.name: Will of the Forsaken
abilities.effect: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Instantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects.

abilities.name: Cannibalize
abilities.effect: 5 yd range, Instant, 2 min cooldown. When activated, regenerates 7% of total Health and 7% of total Mana every 2 sec for 10 sec. Only works on Humanoid or Undead corpses within 5 yds. Any movement, action, or damage taken while Cannibalizing will cancel the effect.

abilities.name: Touch of the Grave
abilities.effect: Your spells and attacks with a damage part have a chance (30% for casters, 20% for Paladins, Rogues and Warriors) to drain Health from the target, up to 5% of your maximum Health. 15 sec internal cooldown. Does not break crowd control.

abilities.name: War Stomp
abilities.effect: 0.5 sec cast, 1.5 min cooldown. Stuns up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 2 sec.

abilities.name: Endurance
abilities.effect: Total Health increased by 5%.

abilities.name: Cultivation
abilities.effect: Instant. Cultivate a nearby herb, growing a duplicate you can harvest without requiring Herbalism skill. Each herb may only be cultivated once. In play it goes on a 15 min cooldown, though its tooltip shows none.

abilities.name: Plainsrunning
abilities.effect: Gain 2% increased movement speed every 5 sec spent moving, up to a maximum of 60% increase. Taking damage or standing still will reduce this effect. Does not increase mounted movement speed.

abilities.name: Berserking
abilities.effect: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Increases your spellcasting and attack speed by 10% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.effect: Health regeneration rate increased by 20%. In addition, 20% of total Health regeneration will continue during combat.

abilities.name: Beast Slaying
abilities.effect: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

abilities.name: Rapid Regeneration
abilities.effect: Channeled, 3 min cooldown. Regenerate 50% of your maximum Health over 6 sec. Any movement, action, or damage taken will cancel the effect.

abilities.name: Walk on Air
abilities.effect: Instant, 1.5 min cooldown. Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel.

abilities.name: Skysight
abilities.effect: 0.5 sec cast, 2 min cooldown. Increases your movement speed by 15% for 15 sec. Used at an elemental convergence it also grants Charged for 1 hour, which raises the bonus to 30%. Charged persists through death and ends when you enter a raid.

abilities.name: Elemental Insight
abilities.effect: Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%.

abilities.name: Wind Blessed
abilities.effect: Increases your spellcasting, melee, and ranged Haste by 2%.

abilities.name: Ruthless
abilities.effect: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 1%.

abilities.name: The Human Spirit
abilities.effect: Spirit increased by 10%.

abilities.name: Perception
abilities.effect: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Dramatically increases stealth detection for 20 sec.

abilities.name: Will to Survive
abilities.effect: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Instantly removes all Stun effects.

abilities.name: Find Treasure
abilities.effect: Instant. Allows the dwarf to sense nearby treasure, making it appear on the minimap and sometimes increase treasure found. Lasts until canceled.

abilities.name: Stoneform
abilities.effect: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Instantly removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison, and Disease effects, and reduces all Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec.

abilities.name: Artisan's Precision
abilities.effect: Increases hit chance with spells and attacks by 1%.

abilities.name: Big Game Hunter
abilities.effect: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

abilities.name: Shadowmeld
abilities.effect: Instant, 10 sec cooldown. Activate to slip into the shadows, reducing the chance for enemies to detect your presence. Lasts until cancelled or upon moving. Using this ability in combat discourages enemies from attacking you, but increases the cooldown to 2 min.

abilities.name: Quickness
abilities.effect: Dodge chance increased by 1% and movement speed increased by 2%. Night Elf Rogues and Druids are harder to detect in Stealth as if they were 1 level higher.

abilities.name: Wisp Spirit
abilities.effect: Transform into a wisp upon death, increasing movement speed by 75%.

abilities.name: Elune's Light
abilities.effect: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 10% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Escape Artist
abilities.effect: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Instantly escape the effects of any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to those effects for 3 sec.

abilities.name: Expansive Mind
abilities.effect: Maximum Mana, Rage or Energy increased by 5%, whichever your class uses.

abilities.name: Engineering Specialization
abilities.effect: Your gnomish ingenuity reduces the rate of engineering devices failing or backfiring when you use them by 20%.

abilities.name: Eureka!
abilities.effect: Instant, 2 min cooldown. For 8 sec, your non-periodic damaging abilities cost 10% less (Mana, Rage or Energy) and deal 10% more damage. For Priests, your non-periodic damaging or healing abilities cost 10% less Mana and do 10% more damage or healing. Periodic effects get nothing from it; a channeled spell is not periodic. The Mage's own tooltip is the one that leaves out non-periodic.

abilities.name: Walk on Air
abilities.effect: Instant, 1.5 min cooldown. Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel.

abilities.name: Read Leyline
abilities.effect: 0.5 sec cast, 2 min cooldown. Increases your Health and Mana regeneration by 50% for 15 sec. Used at a Ley Line it also grants Attuned for 1 hour, which raises the bonus to 100%. Attuned persists through death and ends when you enter a raid. Cannot be used while Innervate is active.

abilities.name: Elemental Insight
abilities.effect: Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%.

abilities.name: Wind Blessed
abilities.effect: Increases your spellcasting, melee, and ranged Haste by 2%.

paladin.name: Judgement
paladin.summary: Changed: it no longer eats your seal. 10 yd range, 10 sec cooldown. Judging Seal of Fury taunts for 3 sec since the launch realms' hotfix of 30 Oct.

paladin.name: Seal of Fury
paladin.summary: The tank seal: every hit adds Holy damage, and with a shield up an absorb worth half of it. Level 10, ranks to 58.

paladin.name: Holy Strike
paladin.summary: Baseline Ret strike, 10 sec cooldown: weapon damage plus Holy. Level 6, ranks to 60. Several talents build on it.

paladin.name: Blessing of Kings and Consecration
paladin.summary: Both trainable now, not talents. Consecration at level 20.

priest.name: Penance
priest.summary: New Discipline channel: Holy damage or healing, instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec, 12 sec cooldown. Rank 1 from the talent at 30, ranks 2 to 4 at 40, 50 and 60.

priest.name: Binding Heal
priest.summary: New 1.5 sec cast: heals a friend and you at once, low threat. Trainers teach it at 25, ranks 2 to 6 from 32 to 56; Holy Binding took the talent's slot.

priest.name: Prayer of Mending
priest.summary: New: a heal that goes off when the target is hit or healed, then jumps to a party or raid member within 20 yd, up to 5 times. Instant, 10 sec cooldown. Rank 1 from the talent at 40, ranks at 50 and 60.

priest.name: Shadow Word: Death
priest.summary: New Shadow nuke, 18 sec cooldown, ranks at 32, 40, 48 and 56. If the target survives you take 30% of your max health, and nothing when the spell misses. Early Demise adds 15 or 30% crit on targets at or below 20% health.

hunter.name: Aimed Shot
hunter.summary: Trainable now, not a talent, and quicker: 2 sec cast (Classic 3), 6 sec cooldown shared with Multi-Shot. Level 20, ranks to 60. A reader caught the cast time on Xaryu's stream.

hunter.name: Call Owl
hunter.summary: Call Pet is named after your pet. The demo Hunter's read Call Owl.

hunter.name: Aspect of the Beast
hunter.summary: Changed: rank 1 makes you untrackable and adds 50 melee attack power (Classic: untrackable only). Spotted by a reader on Xaryu's stream.

mage.name: Comprehend Scroll
mage.summary: New little ability: decipher an untranslated scroll. Level 6.

mage.name: Arcane Blast
mage.summary: New. Rank 1 from the Arcane talent, ranks 2 to 5 at 30, 40, 50 and 60.

mage.name: Ice Lance
mage.summary: New. Rank 1 from the Frost talent, five more ranks from 28 to 56.

mage.name: Frostfire Bolt
mage.summary: New at 40, ranks at 50 and 60: a bolt that is both Fire and Frost. Missile Barrage, Accelerant and Heating Up name it.

mage.name: Teleport: Dalaran
mage.summary: New at 50. The files give it to Alliance races only and the class trainer does not sell it; where it is learned is not known yet.

warlock.name: Bane of Agony
warlock.summary: Curse of Agony, renamed. Bane of Doom the same. Banes and Curses are separate now, so you can run one of each.

warrior.name: Rage
warrior.summary: From damage taken and your swings. Slower weapons give more Rage a swing, so it comes in at a steady rate. Out of combat you lose 1.25 Rage a second. From the Rage tooltip and Blizzard's Class Highlights video (0:23).

warrior.name: Victory Rush
warrior.summary: Baseline, Arms tab. Instant, 30 sec cooldown: a melee hit that heals 10% of your max health, within 20 sec of a non-trivial kill. Read off Soda's stream via a reader.

warrior.name: Tactical Mastery
warrior.summary: A passive in the Arms tab now, not a talent: keep up to 10 Rage when you change stances, and Improved Tactical Mastery adds up to 15 more. From Soda's Warrior video via a reader.

warrior.name: Intercept
warrior.summary: Unchanged from Classic: level 30 in the Fury tab, ranks at 42 and 52. Improved Intercept stays in the Fury tree.

warrior.name: Slam
warrior.summary: A new rank 1 at 20; Classic's four ranks follow at 30, 38, 46 and 54, one rank number higher. 15 sec cooldown now, down from 18 in Blizzard's 2 Nov notes (Classic had none).

warrior.name: Thunder Clap
warrior.summary: Works in Battle or Defensive Stance. Rank 4 slows attacks 20% for 22 sec on up to 4 targets (Classic 10%). Xaryu's stream via a reader; the Classic number from the files.

warrior.name: Bloodrage
warrior.summary: Still there, Protection tab: 20% of your base health for 10 Rage, plus 10 more over 10 sec.

warrior.name: Shield Wall
warrior.summary: Changed: 15 min cooldown, 60% less damage for 12 sec (Classic 30 min, 75% for 10 sec). No shared cooldown with Retaliation and Recklessness any more: each has its own timer, and Blizzard's Class Highlights video (1:14) says so. Two readers flagged it first.

warrior.name: Shield Block
warrior.summary: Changed: 2 charges and 7 sec (Classic 1 block for 5 sec). Still 10 Rage, 5 sec cooldown, Defensive Stance. From a Tyler1 spellbook screenshot a reader sent in.

rogue.name: Energy
rogue.summary: Comes back 1 point every 0.1 sec, 10 a second: Classic's rate with no tick to wait for. From the Energy tooltip and Blizzard's Class Highlights video (3:41).

rogue.name: Mutilate
rogue.summary: New talent, at the bottom of Assassination (row 7) since Blizzard's 2 Nov notes: both weapons at 90% weapon damage each plus 36 at rank 1 (75% before), 20% more on poisoned targets, 2 combo points. Remorseless Attacks, Lethality, Cold Blood, Puncturing Wounds and Opportunity name it.

rogue.name: Venom
rogue.summary: New talent, Assassination row 5, and a passive since Blizzard's 2 Nov notes, no longer a finisher: your new Shank raises your poison damage by 30% and your chance to apply poisons by 20% for 6 sec.

rogue.name: Axes
rogue.summary: Rogues can use one-handed axes now. The Hack and Slash talent lists Axe/Sword as a weapon group.

druid.name: Omen of Clarity and Nature's Grasp
druid.summary: Both trainable now, not talents, in the Balance tab: Nature's Grasp at 10, Omen of Clarity (a passive now) at 20.

druid.name: Revive
druid.summary: New out-of-combat resurrection, 10 sec cast. Rebirth keeps its 30 min cooldown.

druid.name: Lacerate
druid.summary: Bear bleed from later expansions. A Feral talent since the launch realms' hotfix of 30 Oct (row 4): the talent teaches rank 1 at 25, trainers rank 2 at 34 and ranks 3 to 5 at 42, 50 and 58. Shredding Attacks cuts its Rage cost. Thanks to a reader.

druid.name: Cure Poison
druid.summary: Still here: level 14 from the quest Power over Poison, as in Classic. Since build 70170 High Order Skyborne can take that quest too (Blizzard's notes).

shaman.name: Lightning Bolt
shaman.summary: Ranks 4 to 10 cast in 2.5 sec, half a second under Classic's 3. Ranks 1 to 3 keep 1.5, 2 and 2.5 sec.

shaman.name: Chain Lightning
shaman.summary: A 2.5 sec cast again, as in Classic, since Blizzard's 2 Nov notes (it was 2 sec on the beta before): 6 sec cooldown, 3 targets, each jump 30% weaker, and its first hit about 145% of the same rank Lightning Bolt's base damage. Max Elemental Alacrity takes both down to 2 sec.

shaman.name: Totemic Call
shaman.summary: New: your totems teleport to where you stand, on a 30 sec cooldown. Called Totemic Projection until Blizzard's 2 Nov notes, when it moved them to a spot you picked up to 30 yd away. Totemic Recall is in too.

shaman.name: Totems last 5 min
shaman.summary: Lasting totems last 5 min now (most were 2 min in Classic; Healing Stream and Mana Spring 1 min). Searing (30 to 55 sec by rank), Magma (20), Stoneclaw (15), Earthbind and Grounding (45) and Mana Tide (12) keep their short timers. Blizzard's Class Highlights video (3:00) says five minutes.

shaman.name: Call of the Elements, Ancestors and Spirits
shaman.summary: New: each drops up to four totems from its own Totem Bar set in one 3 sec cast. Elements at 20, Ancestors at 30, Spirits at 40.

shaman.name: Ghost Wolf
shaman.summary: Still a 3 sec cast, but Improved Ghost Wolf takes 1 sec off at rank 1 and all 3 at rank 2, and lets it work indoors: instant at 2/2, as Guzu's tooltip showed.

shaman.name: Fire Nova
shaman.summary: A spell now, not a totem: 30 yd range, instant, 10 sec cooldown, blasts everything within 10 yd of your Fire totem (rank 3 at 32: 126 to 142; rank 5 at 52: 232 to 258). Trial by Fire trims 2 or 4 sec off the cooldown.
